requirement: Commits in a site's baseline repo start no detached git gc, and teardown waits out one still running

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026 dev Mac, twice: deleting a site whose install had failed (initb-0510-wpz-a3) stopped at teardown step 3 with "rm: cannot remove '.../webroot-baseline.git': Directory not empty"; the one file left was gc.log ('unable to read 95727ea4...', 'failed to run repack') written by a detached automatic gc the baseline commit had started (ledger L14b). Red 9610fb9e2 (4 cases not ok on 04a0c6da2), fix cd45fa2b6.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 26). Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): with git told to gc at once (gc.auto=1, foreground), a baseline commit and a moment leave no pack behind, every git call the webroot scripts make on a site repo carries the no-maintenance config, and teardown waits a bounded while for a gc.pid naming a live process on this host before removing the directory.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
